card.fires_on: Mostly the period in the section number 6.1 inside cross-references like "Adverse Reactions (6.1)", and the word "respiratory" before drive or depression. It also fires on scattered words like "an" in anaphylaxis or "may" before precipitate.

modes.description: The period between 6 and 1 in a bracketed Adverse Reactions section citation.

modes.label: Respiratory before depression
modes.description: The word respiratory right before drive or depression in opioid-related text.
